scope: Non-operational computational analysis of de-identified public longitudinal viral-load data. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, clinical recommendation, or treatment claim.

origin.preceding_internal_evidence: C033 found a pre-frozen secondary global positive saliva-minus-nasal mirror-hysteresis tendency in an earlier daily cohort but failed its stricter local FIRST_BREAK primary endpoint. C034 does not relabel C033; it defines a new geometric observable for a separate unseen cohort.

primary_target.dataset: Extreme Differences in SARS-CoV-2 Omicron Viral Loads Among Specimen Types
known_before_freeze: 14 incident Omicron participants were reported in the associated article
paired longitudinal saliva, nasal and throat viral loads were collected
the article reports that oral loads often began rising before nasal loads
workbook values, sheet structure and participant-level trajectories have not been inspected in this C034 pass

geometric_observable.coordinates: For each paired visit with quantifiable saliva and anterior-nares viral loads, x=log10(nasal viral load), y=log10(saliva viral load). If the workbook already stores log10 loads, use those values directly; if it stores positive copies-per-volume, transform with log10. Schema binding must document which applies before computation.
geometric_observable.trajectory: Order paired visits by the source collection timestamp/visit order. Do not sort by viral load and do not align by a fitted model.
geometric_observable.signed_loop_area: A_i = 0.5 * sum_j (x_j*y_{j+1}-x_{j+1}*y_j), with the chronological polyline closed by connecting last point to first point.
geometric_observable.normalized_area: a_i=A_i/((max(x)-min(x))*(max(y)-min(y))). Subjects with zero range in either axis are ineligible.
geometric_observable.time_reverse_property: Reversing the same ordered trajectory exactly changes A_i to -A_i; translation by a constant assay offset does not change A_i.
geometric_observable.orientation_prediction: With x=nasal and y=saliva, saliva-leading-nasal dynamics predict a negative (clockwise) signed loop area.

eligibility.missing_or_below_quantification: Exclude that paired visit rather than substitute an arbitrary exact value. Do not interpolate missing visits.
eligibility.duplicate_timestamp: If multiple records conflict at the same subject/timestamp for the same specimen, mark that timestamp ambiguous and exclude it rather than averaging.

primary_hypothesis.statement: Independent Omicron paired saliva/nasal trajectories have a consistently clockwise specimen-phase hysteresis loop, showing that the saliva↔nasal mapping is path-dependent rather than single-valued over infection progression.
primary_hypothesis.frozen_sign_test: two-sided exact sign test for subject normalized-area sign, p<=0.01
primary_hypothesis.frozen_permutation: 10,000 deterministic within-subject chronology permutations, seed 34034; statistic is the cohort median normalized signed area; p=(1+count(null_median<=observed_median))/10001
primary_hypothesis.PASS: at least 10 eligible subjects, median normalized area<=-0.10, exact sign-test p<=0.01 in the predicted negative direction, and chronology-permutation p<=0.01
primary_hypothesis.FAIL: median normalized area>=0, or robust opposite-direction sign test p<=0.01, or either frozen null p>0.05
primary_hypothesis.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: eligibility below minimum or intermediate result

anti_posthoc: Both direction and magnitude threshold are frozen before workbook values/sheets are inspected.
No participant exclusion based on observed loop direction or effect.
No change from saliva/nasal to throat/nasal after result; throat is not part of the C034 primary endpoint.
No threshold relaxation after seeing eligible sample count or p-values.

scientific_interpretation_if_pass.allowed: A cross-compartment viral-load state map can exhibit reproducible trajectory hysteresis; a static one-to-one conversion between specimen types is representation-incomplete for this cohort.
not_allowed: the direction is universal across viruses or variants
SCIENTIFIC_BREAKTHROUGH before independent replication and prior-art/material-consequence gates

next_gates_if_pass: independent second cohort with paired longitudinal nasal+saliva values and no threshold retuning
post-result prior-art killer search for signed loop area / hysteresis / path-dependent specimen mapping in within-host viral-load data
material-consequence test: compare static specimen conversion versus phase-aware/hysteretic representation on held-out data
